name: sql_executor.py
summary: Executes SQL queries against datasets via SQLite and materializes results as structured data.
purpose: Enables the AI query pipeline to run generated or custom SQL against application datasets in a controlled backend environment, translating database operations into consumable data for downstream analytics or user responses.
responsibilities: Execute SQL queries against SQLite dataset representations
Retrieve dataset metadata and paths via DatasetRepository
Materialize query results into pandas DataFrames or equivalent structures
Manage temporary database connections and file system resources
Validate and sanitize execution context to prevent unauthorized access
architecture_notes: Located in the AI service layer, this component serves as the execution bridge between AI-generated SQL (from ai_query_service.py) and physical datasets. It leverages SQLite for lightweight, file-based SQL processing and pandas for result serialization. The dependency on DatasetRepository follows the Repository pattern to decouple data location from execution logic, while Django settings provide environment-specific configuration. It is designed as a stateless service per request, though connection management should be considered.
improvements: Replace raw sqlite3 with SQLAlchemy or a pluggable query engine abstraction for better portability
Implement query sandboxing with strict allow-lists and SQL injection defenses
Add resource limits (timeouts, row caps, memory guards) to prevent denial-of-service
Introduce async execution support to prevent blocking the main Django thread
Add structured logging and query audit trails for observability
